Alif Laam Meem
Kya logon ne yeh khayaal kar rakha hai ke woh sirf is baat par chhod diye jaayenge ke woh yeh keh dein ke hum imaan le aaye hain aur un ka imtehaan nahin hoga
Beshak hum ne un se pehle waalon ka bhi imtehaan liya hai, aur Allah to bahar-haal yeh jaanna chaahta hai ke un mein kaun log sachche hain aur kaun jhoote hain
Kya buraai karne waalon ka khayaal yeh hai ke hum se aage nikal jaayenge? Yeh bahut ghalat faisla kar rahe hain
Jo bhi Allah ki mulaaqaat ki umeed rakhta hai use maaloom rahe ke woh muddat yaqeenan aane waali hai, aur woh Khuda Samee' bhi hai aur Aleem bhi hai
Aur jis ne bhi jihaad kiya hai us ne apne liye jihaad kiya hai, aur Allah to saare aalameen se be-niyaaz hai
Aur jo log imaan laaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye hum yaqeenan un ke gunaahon ki parda-poshi karenge aur inhein un ke aamaal ki behtareen jaza ata karenge

Aur hum ne insaan ko maa baap ke saath nek bartaao karne ki naseehat ki hai, aur bataaya hai ke agar woh kisi aisi shai ko mera shareek banaane par majboor karein jis ka tumhein ilm nahin hai to khabardaar un ki itaa'at na karna, ke tum sab ki baazgasht meri hi taraf hai, phir main bataaoonga ke tum log kya kar rahe the
Aur jin logon ne imaan ikhtiyaar kiya aur nek aamaal kiye hum yaqeenan inhein nek bandon mein shaamil kar lenge

Aur ba'z log aise hain jo kehte hain ke hum Allah par imaan le aaye, us ke baad jab raah-e-Khuda mein koi takleef hui to logon ke fitne ko azaab-e-Khuda jaisa qaraar de diya, haalaanke aap ke Parwardigar ki taraf se koi madad aa jaati to fauran keh dete ke hum to aap hi ke saath the. To kya Khuda un baaton se baakhabar nahin hai jo aalameen ke dilon mein hain
Aur woh yaqeenan unhein bhi jaanna chaahta hai jo saahibaan-e-imaan hain aur unhein bhi jaanna chaahta hai jo munaafiq hain

Aur yeh kuffaar imaan laane waalon se kehte hain ke tum hamaare raaste ka ittibaa' kar lo, hum tumhaare gunaahon ke zimmedaar hain, haalaanke woh kisi ke gunaahon ka bojh uthaane waale nahin hain aur saraasar jhoote hain
Aur inhein ek din apna bojh bhi uthaana hi padega aur us ke saath un logon ka bhi, aur roz-e-qiyaamat un se un baaton ke baare mein sawaal bhi kiya jaaega jin ka yeh iftira kiya karte the
Aur hum ne Nooh alaihis-salaam ko un ki qaum ki taraf bheja aur woh un ke darmiyaan pachaas saal kam ek hazaar saal rahe, phir qaum ko toofaan ne apni giraft mein le liya ke woh log zaalim the
Phir hum ne Nooh alaihis-salaam ko aur un ke saath kashti waalon ko najaat de di aur use aalameen ke liye ek nishaani qaraar de diya
Aur Ibraheem ko yaad karo jab unhon ne apni qaum se kaha ke Allah ki ibaadat karo aur us se daro ke isi mein tumhaare liye behtari hai agar tum kuch jaante ho

Tum Khuda ko chhod kar sirf buton ki parastish karte ho aur apne paas se jhooth gadhte ho. Yaad rakho ke Khuda ke ilaawa jin ki bhi parastish karte ho woh tumhaare rizq ke maalik nahin hain. Rizq Khuda ke paas talaash karo aur usi ki ibaadat karo, usi ka shukriya ada karo ke tum sab usi ki baargaah mein waapas le jaaye jaaoge
Aur agar tum takzeeb karoge to tum se pehle bahut si qaumein yeh kaam kar chuki hain, aur rasool ki zimmedaari to sirf waazeh taur par paighaam ka pahuncha dena hai
Kya un logon ne nahin dekha ke Khuda kis tarah makhlooqaat ko eejaad karta hai aur phir dobaara waapas le jaata hai? Yeh sab Allah ke liye bahut aasaan hai

Aap keh dijiye ke tum log zameen mein sair karo aur dekho ke Khuda ne kis tarah khilqat ka aaghaaz kiya hai, us ke baad wahi aakhirat mein dobaara eejaad karega, beshak wahi har shai par qudrat rakhne waala hai
Woh jis par chaahta hai azaab karta hai aur jis par chaahta hai rahm karta hai, aur tum sab usi ki taraf palataaye jaaoge
Aur tum zameen ya aasmaan mein use aajiz kar sakne waale nahin ho, aur us ke ilaawa tumhaara koi sarparast ya madadgaar bhi nahin hai
Aur jo log Khuda ki nishaaniyon aur us ki mulaaqaat ka inkaar karte hain woh meri rehmat se maayoos hain, aur un ke liye dardnaak azaab hai

To un ki qaum ka jawaab is ke ilaawa kuch na tha ke inhein qatl kar do ya aag mein jala do. To Parwardigar ne inhein us aag se najaat dila di. Beshak is mein bhi saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye bahut si nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain

Aur Ibraheem ne kaha ke tum ne sirf zindagaani-e-duniya ki mohabbaton ko barqaraar rakhne ke liye Khuda ko chhod kar buton ko ikhtiyaar kar liya hai. Us ke baad roz-e-qiyaamat tum mein se har ek doosre ka inkaar karega aur ek doosre par la'nat karega, jab ke tum sab ka anjaam Jahannam hoga aur tumhaara koi madadgaar na hoga
Phir Loot Ibraheem par imaan le aaye aur unhon ne kaha ke main apne Rab ki taraf hijrat kar raha hoon ke wahi saahib-e-izzat aur saahib-e-hikmat hai

Aur hum ne inhein Is'haaq aur Ya'qoob jaisi aulaad ata ki, aur phir un ki zurriyat mein kitaab aur nubuwwat qaraar di, aur inhein duniya mein bhi un ka ajr ata kiya, aur aakhirat mein bhi un ka shumaar nek kirdaar logon mein hoga
Aur phir Loot ko yaad karo jab unhon ne apni qaum se kaha ke tum log aisi badkaari kar rahe ho jo saare aalam mein tum se pehle kabhi kisi ne bhi nahin ki hai

Tum log mardon se jinsi ta'alluqaat paida kar rahe ho aur raaste qat'a kar rahe ho aur apni mehfilon mein buraaiyon ko anjaam de rahe ho. To un ki qaum ke paas is ke ilaawa koi jawaab na tha ke agar tum saadiqeen mein se ho to woh azaab-e-Ilaahi le aao jis ki khabar de rahe ho
To Loot ne kaha: Parwardigar! Tu is fasaad phailaane waali qaum ke muqaable mein meri madad farma
Aur jab hamaare numaainda farishte Ibraheem ke paas bashaarat le kar aaye aur unhon ne yeh khabar sunaayi ke hum is basti waalon ko halaak karna chaahte hain ke is basti ke log bade zaalim hain

To Ibraheem ne kaha ke is mein to Loot bhi hain. Unhon ne jawaab diya ke hum sab se baakhabar hain, hum inhein aur un ke ghar waalon ko najaat de denge ilaawa un ki zauja ke, ke woh peechhe reh jaane waalon mein hai

Phir jab hamaare farishte Loot ke paas aaye to woh pareshaan ho gaye aur un ki mehmaani ki taraf se dil tang hone lage. Un logon ne kaha ke aap darein nahin aur pareshaan na hon, hum aap ko aur aap ke ghar waalon ko bacha lenge, sirf aap ki zauja ko nahin ke woh peechhe reh jaane waalon mein ho gayi hai
Hum is basti par aasmaan se azaab naazil karne waale hain ke yeh log badi badkaari kar rahe hain
Aur hum ne is basti mein se saahibaan-e-aql o hosh ke liye khuli hui nishaani baaqi rakhi hai

Aur hum ne Madyan ki taraf un ke bhai Shu'aib ko bheja to unhon ne kaha ke logo! Allah ki ibaadat karo aur roz-e-aakhirat se umeedein waabasta karo aur khabardaar zameen mein fasaad na phailaate phiro
To un logon ne inhein jhutla diya, aur nateeje mein inhein ek zalzale ne apni giraft mein le liya aur woh apne gharon mein aundhe zaanu ke bal pade rahe

Aur Aad o Samood ko yaad karo ke tum logon ke liye un ke ghar bhi sar-e-raah waazeh ho chuke hain, aur Shaitaan ne un ke liye un ke aamaal ko aaraasta kar diya tha aur inhein raaste se rok diya tha, haalaanke woh log bahut hoshyaar the

Aur Qaaroon, Fir'aun o Haamaan ko bhi yaad dilaao jin ke paas Moosa khuli hui nishaaniyaan le kar aaye to un logon ne zameen mein istikbaar se kaam liya, haalaanke woh hum se aage jaane waale nahin the

Phir hum ne har ek ko us ke gunaah mein giraftaar kar liya. Kisi par aasmaan se pattharon ki baarish kar di, kisi ko ek aasmaani cheekh ne pakad liya, aur kisi ko zameen mein dhansa diya, aur kisi ko paani mein gharq kar diya, aur Allah kisi par zulm karne waala nahin hai, balke yeh log khud apne nafs par zulm kar rahe hain

Aur jin logon ne Khuda ko chhod kar doosre sarparast bana liye hain un ki misaal makdi jaisi hai ke us ne ghar to bana liya, lekin sab se kamzor ghar makdi ka ghar hota hai, agar un logon ke paas ilm o idraak ho
Beshak Allah khoob jaanta hai ke use chhod kar yeh log kise pukaar rahe hain, aur woh badi izzat waala aur saahib-e-hikmat hai
Aur yeh misaalein hum tamaam aalam-e-insaaniyat ke liye bayaan kar rahe hain, lekin inhein saahibaan-e-ilm ke ilaawa koi nahin samajh sakta hai
Allah ne aasmaan aur zameen ko haq ke saath paida kiya hai, aur is mein saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye us ki qudrat ki nishaani paayi jaati hai

Aap jis kitaab ki aap ki taraf wahi ki gayi hai use padh kar sunaayein aur namaaz qaaim karein, ke namaaz har buraai aur badkaari se rokne waali hai, aur Allah ka zikr bahut badi shai hai, aur Allah tumhaare kaarobaar se khoob baakhabar hai

Aur ahl-e-kitaab se munaazira na karo magar us andaaz se jo behtareen andaaz hai, ilaawa un ke jo un mein se zaalim hain, aur yeh kaho ke hum us par imaan laaye hain jo hamaari aur tumhaari dono ki taraf naazil hua hai, aur hamaara aur tumhaara khuda ek hi hai, aur hum sab usi ke itaa'at-guzaar hain

Aur isi tarah hum ne aap ki taraf kitaab naazil ki, to jin logon ko hum ne kitaab di hai woh is kitaab par imaan rakhte hain, aur in mein se bhi ba'z log imaan rakhte hain, aur hamaari aayaat ka inkaar kaafiron ke ilaawa koi nahin karta hai
Aur aye Paighambar! Aap is Quran se pehle na koi kitaab padhte the aur na apne haath se kuch likhte the, warna yeh ahl-e-baatil shubhe mein pad jaate
Dar-haqeeqat yeh Quran chand khuli hui aayaton ka naam hai jo un ke seenon mein mahfooz hain jinhein ilm diya gaya hai, aur hamaari aayaat ka inkaar zaalimon ke ilaawa koi nahin karta hai

Aur yeh log kehte hain ke aakhir un par Parwardigar ki taraf se aayaat kyon nahin naazil hoti hain? To aap keh dijiye ke aayaat sab Allah ke paas hain, aur main to sirf waazeh taur par azaab-e-Ilaahi se daraane waala hoon

Kya un ke liye yeh kaafi nahin hai ke hum ne aap par kitaab naazil ki hai jis ki un ke saamne tilaawat ki jaati hai, aur yaqeenan is mein rehmat aur imaandaar qaum ke liye yaad-dahaani ka saamaan maujood hai

Aap keh dijiye ke hamaare aur tumhaare darmiyaan gawaahi ke liye Khuda kaafi hai jo aasmaan aur zameen ki har cheez se baakhabar hai, aur jo log baatil par imaan rakhte hain aur Allah ka inkaar karte hain woh yaqeenan khasaara uthaane waale log hain
Aur yeh log azaab ki jaldi kar rahe hain, haalaanke agar us ka waqt mu'ayyan na hota to ab tak azaab aa chuka hota, aur woh achaanak hi aaega jab inhein sha'oor bhi na hoga
Yeh azaab ki jaldi kar rahe hain, haalaanke Jahannam yaqeenan kaafiron ko apne ghere mein lene waala hai
Jis din azaab inhein oopar se aur neeche se dhaank lega aur kahega ke ab apne aamaal ka maza chakho
Mere imaandaar bando! Meri zameen bahut wasee' hai, lihaaza meri hi ibaadat karo
Har nafs maut ka maza chakhne waala hai, us ke baad tum sab hamaari baargaah mein palta kar laaye jaaoge

Aur jo log imaan laaye hain aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye hain inhein hum Jannat ke jharokon mein jagah denge jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi, aur woh hamesha unhi mein rahenge, ke yeh un amal karne waalon ka behtareen ajr hai
Jin logon ne sabr kiya hai aur apne Parwardigar par bharosa karte hain

Aur zameen par chalne waale bahut se aise bhi hain jo apni rozi ka bojh nahin utha sakte hain, lekin Khuda inhein aur tumhein sab ko rizq de raha hai, woh sab ki sunne waala aur sab ke haalaat ka jaanne waala hai
Aur agar aap un se poochhenge ke aasmaan o zameen ko kis ne paida kiya hai aur aaftaab o maahtaab ko kis ne musakhkhar kiya hai to fauran kahenge ke Allah. To yeh kidhar behke chale ja rahe hain
Allah hi jis ke rizq mein chaahta hai wus'at paida kar deta hai aur jis ke rizq ko chaahta hai tang kar deta hai, woh har shai ka khoob jaanne waala hai

Aur agar aap un se poochhenge ke kis ne aasmaan se paani barsaaya hai aur phir zameen ko murda hone ke baad zinda kiya hai to yeh kahenge ke Allah hi hai. To phir keh dijiye ke saari hamd Allah ke liye hai, aur un ki aksariyat aql istemaal nahin kar rahi hai
Aur yeh zindagaani-e-duniya ek khel tamaashe ke siwa kuch nahin hai, aur aakhirat ka ghar hamesha ki zindagi ka markaz hai, agar yeh log kuch jaante aur samajhte hon

Phir jab yeh log kashti mein sawaar hote hain to imaan o aqeede ke poore ikhlaas ke saath Khuda ko pukaarte hain, phir jab woh najaat de kar khushki tak pahuncha deta hai to fauran shirk ikhtiyaar kar lete hain
Taake jo kuch hum ne ata kiya hai us ka inkaar kar dein aur duniya mein maze udaayein, to anqareeb inhein us ka anjaam maaloom ho jaaega

Kya un logon ne nahin dekha ke hum ne un ke waaste ek mahfooz Haram bana diya hai jis ke chaaron taraf log uchak liye jaate hain? To kya yeh baatil par imaan rakhte hain aur Allah ki ne'mat ka inkaar kar dete hain
Aur us se bada zaalim kaun hai jo Allah ki taraf jhooti baaton ki nisbat de ya haq ke aa jaane ke baad bhi us ka inkaar kar de? To kya Jahannam mein kuffaar ka thikaana nahin hai
Aur jin logon ne hamaare haq mein jihaad kiya hai hum inhein apne raaston ki hidaayat karenge, aur yaqeenan Allah husn-e-amal waalon ke saath hai
